description: A yellow tennis ball is in front on a wooden tabletop inside a plain corner with white walls, with both hands held out over the surface. The right hand starts holding the right-hand object (the tennis ball), then tosses it leftward and upward across the space; the left hand moves in to receive it as the ball travels and then it is caught and later passed back toward the right hand, alternating between being a left-hand object and a right-hand object while the other hand stays open and ready beneath it.
